scene.head: with_body
scene.placeText: a terrace above the great lake of her gaslamp desert city at dusk — the brass console of a towering valve organ, its keys and stops linked by gleaming pipes to the fountains below, jets of water leaping in time over the lake, clean white steam curling from the valves and the bulb-lit marquees of the boulevard glowing on the far shore
scene.ownProp: a long brass-capped roll of punched paper music unrolling across the organ keys
scene.outfit: a fountain-diva look fitted to her body — an off-shoulder silver-blue silk gown with a low neckline and brass boning rising like organ pipes, its long skirt slit high to the thigh and tiered at the hem like leaping fountain jets beaded with crystal droplets, lavender lace opera gloves above the elbow, a tall feathered headdress on a brass fountain crest and brass-buckled heels
scene.scene: she is the fountain organist, leaning over the brass console and pressing the stops with both gloved hands as the jets on the lake leap to her music, a loop of punched paper music unrolling across the keys
